summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting execution of a definitive loan agreement with Brazilian Development Bank (BNDES) under the National Civil Aviation Fund (FNAC) program, providing up to R$2.66 billion in long-term financing, with roughly R$1.3 billion drawn September 29, 2026, and the remaining R$1.3 billion expected in 4Q26. The facility has a term of up to five years; Azul is prepaying about R$400 million of higher-cost debt. This is a routine financing/liquidity transaction, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply. Watch leverage, covenants, and any future liability-management actions.
